verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's API v2 docs state that official SDKs exist for PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET, which delivers the core of building against official SDKs across mainstream languages. The sandbox API, which allows unlimited test jobs without consuming credits, adds practical support for development against the API. Missing for 10: per-SDK documentation depth (coverage, maintenance, versioning) beyond a single listing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
